# Global development rules

These rules apply to all code generated in this repository.

## Invariants

* For SharePoint queries use PnPjs library
* Errors must be handled explicitly.
* Use SharePoint Framework (SPFx) development best practices.
* Use React best development practices

## Architecture

* Reuse existing patterns and architecture.
* For custom layout, use following guidelines: https://microsoft-search.github.io/pnp-modern-search/extensibility/custom_layout/
* For custom web component, use following guidelines: https://microsoft-search.github.io/pnp-modern-search/extensibility/custom_web_component/

## Quality bar

* Readable over clever.
* No dead code.
* No speculative features.
